name: ernestdefoe/member-desk
description: Member Desk: an Invision-style members area for Flarum. A searchable, filterable member list with saved filters, bulk actions (groups, suspend, confirm email, mark as spammer, anonymize, delete through flarum/gdpr), a full member page, an audit log and CSV export.

suggest.flarum/gdpr: Anonymize members, and delete them with their content, through GDPR's own erasure
suggest.flarum/suspend: Suspend and unsuspend members, one at a time or in bulk
suggest.flarum/audit: Every Member Desk action also lands in Flarum's audit log
suggest.fof/ban-ips: Filter by banned IP, ban an IP from the member page, and ban a spammer's IPs
suggest.fof/moderator-notes: Private staff notes on the member page
suggest.fof/moderator-warnings: Warnings and strikes on the member page
suggest.fof/masquerade: Custom profile fields on the member page
suggest.ernestdefoe/docket: Reports about a member on their page and in the list: status, assignee and outcome from Docket's report centre
suggest.flarum/flags: Report counts in the list and on the member page (Docket adds statuses)

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
